title: Resurrection Historical/Theological Claim Audit
purpose: Support the primary activity for The Resurrection as Historical and Theological Claim.
body_markdown:
# Resurrection Historical/Theological Claim Audit

Use 1 Corinthians 15:1-28 as your evidence.

1. Write or draw three direct observations.
2. Mark one interpretation or conclusion.
3. Name one careful response.
4. Put a question mark beside anything the passage does not settle by itself.
